translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: ID POKITA
book.title: DOS ID POKITA ni Disas Krays ki Juan

content: Dos Ponolihan woy dos Disok no Sulat

Na nopongnga idda, nokita ku iddos ossa pa no ponolihan no motuus no id pomon diyot datas to langit. Novukusan sikandin to souhapun woy duwon nokolingkus no bountu riyot uu rin. Dos bonnong din, iling to se-aa to allow woy dos pa-a rin, iling to tuddok no apuy.
Duwon id somaddan din no disok no sulat no waa id luun. Id gedda rin kos kowanan no pa-a rin diyot dahat woy dos ivang, id gedda rin diyot livuta.
Na, id pehes sikandin to oray'n monokkaa no immat peheson to movuut no liyun nod inihoo. Nopongnga idda, id tavak iddos pittun baansi.

Id sulat kud nanoy iddos id oseng taddot pittun baansi, piru norinog ku no duwon bawos pomon diyot datas to langit no mid ungketen to, “Yo ru id posaddoo iddos id oseng taddot pittun baansi, woy yo ru idda sulata.”
Na, iddos ponolihan no nokita ku no id lohinat diyot dahat woy riyot livuta, id poratas din kos kowanan no bollad din,

su od totandu sikandin ukit to ngaran to Monamon ma-antoy taman to waad tomanon. Sikandin kos mid bovaa to langit, livuta, dahat woy dos langun no nokota-aw ka-ay. Na id totandu iddos ponolihan, kahi rin to, “Nopongnga ron kos timpu to kod-aangat, oyyos ko-ungkay, od kotuman don en kos langun.

Oyya su riyot timpu nod porohingon don taddot iko-pittun ponolihan iddos trumpeta rin, od tumanon don en to Monama iddos puhawang din no waa pa id posaddoo riyot mgo minuvu, piru id posaddoo rin idda dangan diyot sinuhuwan din no mgo propeta.”

Na, norinog ku mandon iddos bawos pomon diyot datas to langit no mid ungketen to, “Undiyonniyu iddos ponolihan no id lohinat diyon to dahat woy riyot livuta, woy ongayow dos disok no sulat no waa id luun nid somaddan din.”

De-en id poroniyan ku iddos ponolihan, woy id buyu ku kandin iddos disok no sulat. Kahi rin koddi to, “Ini rad kos sulat, ongayow woy kannow. Mammis idda iling to tonnob otik duwon pa to bivig du, piru mopet don otik diyon don to gottok du.”
Na, id angoy ku iddos disok no sulat pomon diyot bollad din woy id ka-an ku idda. Iling en to tonnob kos komommisoy tadda to riyon pa to bivig ku, piru to noommod kud, id mopet don diyot gottok ku.

Nopongnga idda, id ikohiyan a nikandin to, “Ko-ilangan no id posaddoo ru mandon iddos id poponudtuu to Monama kikow ko ondan kos od kotomanan diyot nokod-osso-osson tribu, nokod-osso-osson kinohiyan, woy riyon to nokod-osso-osson ingod woy riyot mgo hari ran.”
